conventions: Serialized Unity rest transforms after Animator.Rebind, before sampling animations. All paths relative to the Animator. Quaternions are xyzw in Unity. Local positions are native local units (ancestor scales apply), avatar-relative positions use the prefab's metre-based root. Each bindpose maps renderer local to joint bind space; row-major 4 x 4. Hand position and rotations are target references for calibration; do not equate them with OpenXR source joint axes.

hands.referenceBasisDefinition: Forward = normalized wrist to MiddleProximal. Reference normal = -normalize(cross(IndexProximal-Wrist,LittleProximal-Wrist)). Quaternion = LookRotation(forward,referenceNormal).
Forward = normalized wrist to MiddleProximal. Reference normal = +normalize(cross(IndexProximal-Wrist,LittleProximal-Wrist)). Quaternion = LookRotation(forward,referenceNormal).
